title: 第6章大爆特爆

content_zh:
悦耳的系统提示音响起。
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’击杀‘九级蛟龙’获得经验1000000点，真气10000点，能量值1点。”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’连升五级，目前等级二级战师。”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得‘九级蛟龙精血’。”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得‘风系妖核’是否融合？”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得‘幻系妖核’是否融合？”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得‘水系妖核’是否融合？”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得神技‘屠龙刀法’是否修炼？”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得神器‘屠龙刀（残缺）’”
什么叫着爆？
什么叫着狂暴？
龙飞整个人热血沸腾，这种感觉太爽，太美妙了，简直就是妙不可言。
连升五级，直接成为二级战师。
获得三种属性妖核，这些妖核都是九级巅峰，每一枚都是价值连城，简直好的不能再好的东西。
三枚属性妖核对于神技‘屠龙刀法’来说还差点，可是……这所有的一切加起来都没有神器‘屠龙刀’要爽。
武器：屠龙刀
品级：神器（残缺）
重量：一万三千斤
破坏力：SSS级
描述：诛杀邪魔之神器，对邪恶生物有200%的攻击效果，对龙族有500%攻击效果，附带‘屠龙一击’隐藏功法，激活率1%。

一条怒龙盘踞刀背之上，刀身漆黑，刀刃如雪，刀柄雕刻着龙纹，浑身透着霸气，浑厚无比的狂霸之气。
此物一处，谁与争锋啊？
这根本就不是刀，而是一条怒龙在咆哮。
美中不足的是，这把刀断裂了，只剩下半截。
这就是因为它为什么会残缺。
光是残缺就能拥有如此属性，如果将它完善的话，它的威力会是什么样？无法想象。
“叮！”
“触发隐藏任务！”
“任务：修复屠龙刀。”
“任务等级：S级”
“任务时限：一年”
“任务奖励：100万经验值，1万真气，屠龙一击激活率提升至10%，屠龙刀的秘密！”
“任务线索一，南宫皇族。”
“我擦！”
“额外奖励吗？居然触发了隐藏任务，还是S级的，这是要嗨起来的节奏啊，哈哈哈……”龙飞兴奋的简直就要暴走了。
一切都来的太突然了。
让他兴奋就好像这一切都在做梦一样。
看着脑海里的屠龙刀，意念一动，想要拿出来耍一耍。
“腕力不够，无法使用。”
“我去！”

龙飞不爽一声，看了一下屠龙刀需要的腕力高达九十九点，他现在的腕力才五十点，“这尼玛什么时候才能使用啊，不行，我要快点升级，屠龙刀可是我龙家祖传的宝物，有了这个家伙我看看龙家谁还敢在我面前放半个屁，敢对老子不敬，一刀劈死他。”
屠龙刀消失在火璃山脉，龙家数千年的时间寻找都没有找到，但是龙家弟子对屠龙刀的敬畏从未消失，反而因为失去更为敬重。
因为它代表着祖宗，代表着传承！
现在屠龙刀被他找到，他就是龙家之主！
屠龙刀拿不起，龙飞意念一动，“修炼。”
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’修炼‘屠龙刀法’。”
功法：屠龙刀法
品级：神级
破坏力：S级。
描述：屠龙刀法为七式，开皮，断筋，裂骨，斩血，神开，惊魂，破杀，每一式释放出来的同声都会积攒一层刀气，积攒到七层可以发挥出‘屠龙狂斩’伤害500%。
描述2：屠龙刀法配合屠龙刀，伤害力提升两倍。
“牛逼！”
看着‘屠龙刀法’的属性，龙飞只能说出牛逼两个字。
紧接着。
龙飞将‘风系，幻系，水系’三枚妖核全部融合。
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’对‘风系’领悟提升10%”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’对‘幻系’领悟提升10%。”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’对‘水系’领悟提升10%。”

不多，只有10%点的提升，然而千万不要小看这10%，以后只要龙飞修炼这三种属性的功法威力会提升，修炼的速度也会提升，对这三种属性的攻击防御力会提升10%，非常霸气的属性。
“狂暴，真的太爽了。”
龙天舒服的呻吟一声，这种感觉吊到爆啊。
也在此时。
那头白狼盯着他，龙飞感到一阵压力，立即恢复过来，看着那头白狼真正用乞求的目光看着他。
而此时。
白狼屁股下大出血，龙飞再看着它的肚子，脸色震惊，“真是要生狼崽子啊。”

content_en:
A pleasant system prompt sounded.
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for killing 'Level 9 Dragon' and gaining 1,000,000 experience points, 10,000 Qi points, and 1 energy point."
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for leveling up five times in a row and is currently a level two combat master."
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for obtaining the 'Ninth Level Dragon Essence Blood'."
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for obtaining the 'Wind Demonic Core'. Do you want to fuse it?"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for obtaining the 'Illusion Demonic Core'. Do you want to fuse it?"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for obtaining the 'Water Demonic Core'. Do you want to fuse it?"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for acquiring the magical skill 'Dragon Slaying Sword Technique'. Do you want to practice it?"
“Congratulations to player ‘Long Fei’ for obtaining the artifact ‘Dragon Slaying Knife (Incomplete)’”
What does it mean to explode?
What is violent?
Long Fei's whole body was boiling with excitement. This feeling was so refreshing, so wonderful, it was simply wonderful.
Upgrade five levels in a row and directly become a second-level combat master.
Acquire three kinds of demon cores with attributes. These demon cores are all at the ninth level. Each one is priceless, and it is simply the best thing.
Three attribute demon cores are not enough for the divine skill 'Dragon Slaying Sword Technique', but... all of these combined are not as good as the divine weapon 'Dragon Slaying Sword'.
Weapon: Dragon Slaying Knife
Grade: Artifact (incomplete)
Weight: Thirteen thousand kilograms
Destructive power: SSS level
Description: An artifact that slays evil spirits. It has a 200% attack effect against evil creatures and a 500% attack effect against dragons. It comes with the hidden skill of 'Dragon Slaying Blow' and has an activation rate of 1%.
An angry dragon is entrenched on the back of the knife. The blade is pitch black, the blade is like snow, and the handle is engraved with dragon patterns. It exudes domineering and powerful aura.
This thing is in one place, who can compete with it?
This is not a knife at all, but an angry dragon roaring.
The only fly in the ointment is that the knife broke, leaving only half of it.
That's why it's incomplete.
Just being incomplete can possess such attributes. If it were perfected, what would its power be like? Unimaginable.
"Ding!"
"Trigger the hidden mission!"
"Mission: Repair the Dragon Slaying Knife."
"Mission level: S level"
"Mission time limit: one year"
"Mission reward: 1 million experience points, 10,000 infuriating energy, the activation rate of the dragon-slaying blow is increased to 10%, the secret of the dragon-slaying knife!"
"Mission clue one, Nangong Royal Family."
"I'll wipe it!"
"Extra reward? You actually triggered a hidden mission, and it's S-level. This is the time to get excited, hahaha..." Long Fei was so excited that he almost ran away.
Everything happened so suddenly.
It turned him on as if it was all a dream.
Looking at the dragon-slaying knife in his mind, he suddenly wanted to take it out and play with it.
"I don't have enough wrist strength to use it."
"I'll go!"
Long Fei was unhappy and looked at the fact that the wrist strength required by the Dragon Slaying Sword was as high as ninety-nine points. His current wrist strength was only fifty points. "When can I use this? No, I have to upgrade it quickly. The Dragon Slaying Sword is an ancestral treasure of my Long family. With this guy, I will see who in the Long family dares to fart in front of me or disrespect me. I will kill him with one knife."
The Dragon-Slaying Sword disappeared in the Huoli Mountains, and the Long Family searched for it for thousands of years but could not find it. However, the Long Family's disciples' awe for the Dragon-Slaying Sword has never disappeared. On the contrary, they respect it even more because of the loss.
Because it represents ancestors and inheritance!
Now that he has found the dragon-slaying knife, he is the head of the Long family!
Unable to lift the dragon-slaying knife, Long Fei thought, "Practice."
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for practicing the 'Dragon Slaying Sword Technique'."
Kung Fu: Dragon Slaying Sword Technique
Grade: God level
Destructive power: S level.
Description: The Dragon Slaying Sword Technique consists of seven moves: skin opening, tendon breaking, bone splitting, blood cutting, divine opening, shock, and killing. Each move released will accumulate a layer of sword energy. When accumulated to the seventh level, you can perform the "Dragon Slaying"Crazy Slash’ damage is 500%.
Description 2: Combining the Dragon Slaying Sword Technique with the Dragon Slaying Sword, the damage is doubled.
"Awesome!"
Looking at the attributes of the 'Dragon Slaying Sword Technique', Long Fei could only say one word: awesome.
Immediately afterwards.
Long Fei merged all three demon cores of 'wind element, illusion element, and water element'.
"Ding!"
“Congratulations to player ‘Long Fei’ for improving his understanding of ‘Wind Element’ by 10%”
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for improving his understanding of 'Illusion System' by 10%."
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for improving his understanding of 'Water Element' by 10%."
Not much, only a 10% increase. However, don't underestimate this 10%. In the future, as long as Long Fei practices these three attributes, his power will increase, his practice speed will also increase, and his attack and defense against these three attributes will increase by 10%, which is a very domineering attribute.
"Frenzy, it's really great."
Long Tian groaned in comfort, this feeling was so exciting.
Also at this time.
The white wolf stared at him. Long Fei felt a burst of pressure and immediately recovered, watching the white wolf really look at him with pleading eyes.
And at this time.
The white wolf was bleeding profusely from its buttocks. Long Fei looked at its belly again with a shocked look on his face, "It's really going to give birth to wolf cubs."
